q1_issues.issue: The frame "in the present generation" is hung on the group entity as (In sk_group_1 sk_generation_1) instead of on the predication it restricts — a time modifier on a copular clause is a state-reification trigger ("Alice was ill on Friday"), so the oblique belongs on a reified active state.

As a consequence the distributed conclusion (Member $x active) carries no trace of the restriction, asserting each member is active without qualification — the stated restriction is silently dropped and the claim widened.

notes: The count, the group witness, the refusal to put (Member sk_group_1 active) on the group symbol, and the per-member distribution rule at (STV 1.0 0.9) are all right, and In (not LocatedIn or During) is the correct head for this "in"; only its first argument is wrong.
